title: A missing runtime binding fails closed instead of fabricating a decision
risk: A degraded model or price source silently yields a canned score or a placeholder SKU, and the customer is quoted something no system can justify.
preconditions: Tenant T1 run orc-failclosed-* with the cognitive binding for hypothesis derivation removed
A second variant with the pricing source unavailable while a price would be needed

steps.action: Run the pipeline with the hypothesis binding absent
steps.expected: the run fails closed with an explicit error and no hypothesis, score or routing decision is fabricated

steps.action: Run the pipeline where a price is required but the authoritative price source is unavailable
steps.expected: the action is refused with P_FLOOR_UNAVAILABLE and no locally derived floor is used

steps.action: Submit a skill id that is not registered for the tenant
steps.expected: the run fails closed and no skill execution record is created

steps.action: Read the audit trail for the three failures
steps.expected: each failure is recorded with its error code and the run state is failed or stopped, never success

assertions: Zero fabricated values exist: no score, no routing decision and no price appear in any artifact of the failed runs
The three failures are recorded with their exact error codes and terminal states
No outbound dispatch or order row is created by any failed run
forbidden: Return a hard-coded score, routing decision or placeholder SKU when a binding is missing
Derive a price floor locally when the authoritative source is unavailable
evidence: Failure records with error codes and terminal task states
Artifact scan showing no fabricated score/price plus the zero dispatch evidence
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped task and artifact rows for orc-failclosed-*; keep the failure audit entries
automation: Remove one binding at a time in an isolated run namespace and assert on the absence of fabricated artifacts; the real guard code stays in the path.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
